about: A governor's and a mayor's yearly address (owner, Nov 8: 'the address... governors' and mayors' too'). Each level names the occasion in the English engine's bank (`state-of-the-state`, `town-address`), the office whose holder speaks, the policy level they may act at, and the day of the year it is given. The words, the kind of address and the subjects come from the same places the President's do (src/director/speech-outline.ts and its rows in speech-outlines.json, address-kind.ts, the term read); this holds no sentence.

dayNote.note: Governors give the State of the State when the legislature convenes, most in January and the rest by mid-February.
Mayors give a State of the City in the first quarter, after the year's budget comes due.
